deck_name: Tarot de Besançon / Swiss 1JJ — The Juno & Jupiter Variant

card-junon.name: Juno (in place of the Popess)
card-junon.Scene: A crowned woman is enthroned, holding a sceptre. At her feet or nearby stands a peacock, Juno's sacred bird. She wears classical robes and her bearing is queenly and composed. In the Besançon tradition, Juno (Hera) replaces the Popess (trump II).

card-jupiter.name: Jupiter (in place of the Pope)
card-jupiter.Scene: An enthroned male figure in classical robes holds a thunderbolt or sceptre. An eagle stands nearby or perches on his shoulder. Jupiter (Zeus) replaces the Pope (trump V) in the Besançon tradition.

card-emperor.name: The Emperor (Der Herrscher)
card-emperor.Scene: A crowned emperor in armour sits on a throne holding a sceptre. The 1JJ rendering follows standard Marseille composition in clean engraved line with hand-colouring.

card-chariot.name: The Chariot
card-chariot.Scene: A crowned warrior rides in a canopied chariot drawn by two horses. He holds a sceptre or sword; the canopy is decorated. The 1JJ Chariot follows Marseille composition closely.

card-strength.name: Strength (La Force)
card-strength.Scene: A woman in a long dress gently holds open the jaws of a lion. The composition is the standard Marseille Strength: calm mastery over wild force.

card-temperance.name: Temperance
card-temperance.Scene: A standing angel pours liquid between two vessels. The 1JJ version follows the Marseille Temperance, with the figure shown in a long gown pouring steadily between two pitchers.

card-devil.name: The Devil (Der Teufel)
card-devil.Scene: A horned, winged devil stands on a pedestal; two smaller chained figures are at its feet. The 1JJ Devil follows the Marseille composition, with bat wings and a grim expression.

card-tower.name: The Tower (La Maison de Dieu)
card-tower.Scene: A tall crenellated tower on a rock is struck by fire or lightning from above; the tower's crown is blasted off and two figures fall from the windows.

card-world.name: The World (Le Monde)
card-world.Scene: An androgynous dancing figure is enclosed within an oval wreath. At the four corners appear the tetramorph symbols: angel, eagle, lion, and bull. The 1JJ version follows the Marseille World.

card-swords-ace.name: Ace of Swords
card-swords-ace.Scene: A large upright sword dominates the card, surmounted by a crown from which laurel branches extend. The blade is shown full-length in the Marseille ace-of-swords tradition.

card-cups-two.name: Two of Cups
card-cups-two.Scene: Two cups are shown side by side within a decorative border typical of Marseille-tradition pip cards. The cups are rounded and chalice-like.

card-wands-two.name: Two of Batons
card-wands-two.Scene: Two batons or wands cross within a decorative frame. The 1JJ pip cards show the suit symbols arranged geometrically in the Marseille tradition.

card-coins-three.name: Three of Coins
card-coins-three.Scene: Three coins or discs are arranged in a triangular pattern within the 1JJ-style pip border. Each coin shows a circular ornamental design.

emg-juno-jupiter.name: Juno & Jupiter — The Besançon Substitution
emg-juno-jupiter.Scene: The two famous substitutions of the Besançon tradition side by side: Juno (trump II) with her peacock replaces the Papesse, and Jupiter (trump V) with his eagle and thunderbolt replaces the Pope. Both cards are shown in the 1JJ Tarot engraved style.
